title: dispatch session-discovery registry
description: One entry per project, keyed by its projects.json key: the 'lab' name alone, or '<lab>/<project>' when that entry also sets 'project'. Describes how to discover the project's session directories. See ../README.md for the full field reference.

include.description: Globs (relative to the incoming project dir) whose directory matches are sessions. Matches from all patterns are unioned; only directories count.

exclude.description: Globs to drop from that union, matched against either the session's basename or its path relative to the incoming project dir.
